# OpenAPI Standard Clarification

`public_inventory_api.openapi.yaml` is an **OpenAPI Specification** document. OpenAPI is a vendor-neutral, language-agnostic standard for describing HTTP APIs and is unrelated to OpenAI.

The OpenAPI Specification can be used without membership fees and is published under the Apache License 2.0. The packet uses it only to define endpoints, parameters, response schemas, security headers and error behavior.

Authoritative references:

- https://www.openapis.org/participatehow-to-contribute
- https://spec.openapis.org/oas/v3.1.0.html

No OpenAI SDK, API key, endpoint, model or account is required by this packet.
